description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing self-service scorecards within a Fineract-based system. It includes endpoints to retrieve scorecards by client and to create new scorecards, with security validation ensuring proper client-user mappings.

classes.name: SelfScorecardApiResource
classes.description: A REST resource class providing endpoints for self-service scorecard operations, secured and conditional on module enablement.

methods.name: findByClient
methods.description: Retrieves scorecard data for a specific client after validating client-user mapping.

methods.name: createScorecard
methods.description: Creates a new scorecard for a specific survey after validating client-user mapping.

methods.name: validateAppuserClientsMapping
methods.description: Validates whether the authenticated user is mapped to the specified client.
